title: Baaxok Gubal Tan Maabitina
intro: ucsub soolo xaqut cotiyya xongoloola gubal fayya iyyam kee baad dagal tibba rade wak. Qur'aana ta arac diggoysah: ummatta farmoytit bahtam cineh, digaal alfimteh, kalah kaadu tet qanxaffe seehadayti baxih exxa takke. Woo ayatitteh addat yabtam manni koboxuuy?
clues: Nanu Qur'aanak cankâ migaaqal hinnay inki numih sarrimaaneh addat baxxaqimte koboxul kassitna.
Nanu farmoytit bahte farmo cinneh, oson iyyaanam numma kinni way.
nek kassitta kinnaane ardi bagul tan garuq luk axawah tan, kee too weelo ni migaqih exxa tekke.
xagnisen ayro, nee eyyeeqeenih gira fanah hirriibiseenih.
Nanu digaalak ninni kalalam madudnaay, kay xongolo manaabbe.
Fooca nek girah addat fakkimteeh, nanu kaadu addat kak culenno; essero gacse way, nanu gacsa duude wee marak fanak sugnem axcenno.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Sinni kalalaanam maduudan Girâ xongolo yaabbeenim maduudan.
Amotani caxaaxuwih addat cattiimeh culma yeceenih
outcome.answer: Sinni kalalaanam maduudan Girâ xongolo yaabbeenim maduudan.
